result.instructions: Tools for Jackrabbit Class, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which classes have openings this session, and what do they cost?"; "Who is on the roster for the Tuesday 4pm beginner class?"; "List the students who were absent last week and have a makeup scheduled.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jackrabbit Class data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jackrabbit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jackrabbit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jackrabbit_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. jackrabbit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: The Jackrabbit organization this token accesses: name, email, default currency and logo URL. GET /v1/Options/me.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_custom_field_labels
tools.title: Get custom field labels
tools.description: The organization's own labels for the five family and five student user-defined fields (userField1-5). GET /v1/Options/org-configuration.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_options
tools.title: List option values
tools.description: The allowed values (id, value, description) of one dropdown list in this organization: locations, sessions, rooms, class categories and statuses, instructors, enroll types, drop reasons, genders, grade levels, family statuses and sources, contact types, staff positions, departments, membership types, billing cycles and methods, discount rules, transaction types and sizes. Use the ids as filters on the other tools. GET /v1/Options/{list}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_families
tools.title: List families
tools.description: List family accounts (billing households): name, status, location, primary phone, address, balance, membership, e-payment and discount settings, notes. Filter by status, location, name, phone or last update. GET /v1/Families.

updated_since.description: Only families updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_family
tools.title: Get family
tools.description: One family account by id, with balance, billing and discount settings and notes. GET /v1/Families/{id}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_archived_families
tools.title: List archived families
tools.description: List archived (lead-file) families. GET /v1/Families/archived.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List family contacts (parents, guardians, emergency and pickup contacts): name, type, email, phones, address, primary/billing/authorized-for-pickup flags, opt-outs. GET /v1/Contacts.

phone.description: Phone filter (searches home, work and cell numbers).

primary.description: Only primary contacts (true) or only non-primary (false).

updated_since.description: Only contacts updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id. GET /v1/Contacts/{id}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_authorized_contacts
tools.title: List contacts authorized to pick up a student
tools.description: The contacts authorized to pick up one student. GET /v1/Contacts/authorized/{studentId}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_students
tools.title: List students
tools.description: List students: family, location, status, birth date, gender, grade, school, registration and quit dates, sizes, and health notes (medications, allergies, special needs, doctor). Filter by family, active status, location, last name or dates. GET /v1/Students.

is_active.description: true = active students only, false = inactive only.

birth_date.description: Students born on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

quit_date.description: Students who quit on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_date.description: Students created on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_last_inactive.description: Students last marked inactive on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_since.description: Only students updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_student
tools.title: Get student
tools.description: One student by id with all profile, size and health-note fields. GET /v1/Students/{id}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List staff and instructors: name, status, contact details, positions, employment type, instructor flag, start/end dates. GET /v1/Staff.

is_active.description: true = active staff only, false = inactive only.

created_date.description: Staff created on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_staff_member
tools.title: Get staff member
tools.description: One staff member by id. GET /v1/Staff/{id}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: List classes with schedule (days, start/end time and date), location, room, session, instructors, size, openings, waitlist counts, tuition, age limits and online-registration flags. GET /v1/Classes.

family_id.description: Only classes this family's students are enrolled in.

student_id.description: Only classes this student is enrolled in.

instructor_id.description: Only classes taught by this staff member.

updated_since.description: Only classes updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

archived.description: true = list archived classes instead of active ones.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_class
tools.title: Get class
tools.description: One class by id with its full schedule, capacity, fees and registration settings. GET /v1/Classes/{id}.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_class_roster
tools.title: Get class roster
tools.description: Who is in a class today: class name, start time, location, room, instructors and the roster (student id, name, present, makeup). GET /v1/Classes/{classId}/roster.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_class_listings
tools.title: List class listings (openings)
tools.description: The public-facing class schedule with openings, age ranges, tuition, location address and online registration links, filterable by category, instructor, days, session, location, gender, room and status. GET /v1/ClassListings.

include_closed.description: Include closed classes (overrides the organization setting).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_enrollments
tools.title: List enrollments
tools.description: List enrollments (a student in a class): enroll date and type, enrolled flag, drop date and reason, transfer target. enrolled=true returns only existing enrollments, enrolled=false only dropped ones (omit it for no status filter); future=true lists enrollments that start later. GET /v1/Enrollments (or /v1/Enrollments/future).

enrolled.description: true = only existing enrollments, false = only dropped enrollments.

future.description: true = future-dated enrollments instead of current ones.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_enrollment
tools.title: Get enrollment
tools.description: One enrollment by id (set future=true for a future-dated enrollment). GET /v1/Enrollments/{id} or /v1/Enrollments/future/{id}.

future.description: true = look up a future-dated enrollment.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_attendance
tools.title: List attendance
tools.description: List attendance records (only dates where someone marked attendance): student, class, date, attended, note and makeup details. Filter by student, class, date range, attended and makeup status. GET /v1/Attendance.

class_id.description: Only the original class that was missed or attended.

has_scheduled_makeup.description: Only records with a scheduled makeup.

updated_since.description: Only records updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_list_waitlist_entries
tools.title: List waitlist entries
tools.description: List class waitlist entries: class, student, entry date, position and notes. Filter by class, student or entry date. GET /v1/Classes/waitlist-entries.

entry_date.description: Entries created on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: jackrabbit_get_franchise_revenue_summary
tools.title: Get franchise revenue summary
tools.description: Corporate tokens only: total revenue per franchise organization for a date range. GET /v1/Reports/franchise-revenue-summary.

tools.name: jackrabbit_create_student
tools.title: Create student
tools.description: WRITE: add a new student to an existing family in Jackrabbit (not idempotent: calling twice creates two students). Requires the family id and first name. POST /v1/Students.

family_id.description: The family the student belongs to.

tools.name: jackrabbit_create_waitlist_entry
tools.title: Add student to a class waitlist
tools.description: WRITE: put a student on a class waitlist (not idempotent; Jackrabbit answers 409 if the student is already on it). Does not enroll the student. POST /v1/Classes/waitlist-entries.

position.description: Waitlist position (default: end of the list).

annotations.title: Add student to a class waitlist
